column1: # Book 2 second-round read (Fable, 2026-10-30): every line read against the Latin. No changes.
# 2.1110 caeli domus is the subject of appareret and tolleret: heaven's house shows its room and lifts its roof.
# 2.1125, 2.1136 omnis agrees with cibus, not venas.
# 2.1162 suppeditati is masculine plural: we, scarcely supplied by the fields; "share" was added.

column2: heaven's house could show its room, and lift its lofty roof
while all the food is easily put into their veins, and while
nor is all the food easily distributed into its veins,
we wear down the iron, we whom the fields scarcely supply:
